releases.summary: Introducing the UnityHub in-app update center and a more stable Add Song editor.
changes: UnityHub can check its update service and notify you when a newer version is available.
Download updates from UnityHub storage without opening GitHub or an external download page.
Choose automatic background downloading and review the version tracker and complete release history in Account settings.
Every downloaded package is checked for its expected size, SHA-256 checksum, app identity, version, and signing certificate before Android is asked to install it.
Android displays its own installation confirmation; UnityHub does not silently install or replace the app.
The Add Song ChordPro field now has a controlled height, stable form-item keys, and a live preview that parses in the background after typing pauses.
Large ChordPro drafts are no longer copied into Android's small saved-state bundle.

releases.summary: Service assignment responses now support optional explanations.
changes: Add an optional note of up to 300 characters when marking a service assignment as unable to serve.
Edit a decline note later from the assignment card.
Decline notes are queued with offline responses and synchronized when a connection returns.
Worship leaders can review submitted notes in service assignment lists and the assignment overview.

releases.summary: Manage ministry positions from the Team workspace.
changes: Administrators and worship leaders can add, rename, and delete reusable ministry positions.
Position names are validated for length and duplicate names are checked without regard to letter case.
UnityHub shows how many member profiles use a position before deletion.
